For PTFE, each repeat unit \(-\mathrm{CF_2-CF_2}-\) contains two C–C bonds.

**(a) Fully extended chain**

The projection of one C–C bond along the extended chain is

\[
d\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right)
\]

so the contour length per repeat unit is

\[
2d\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right)
\]

Thus the number of repeat units is

\[
n=\frac{L}{2d\sin(\theta/2)}
=\frac{2000}{2(0.154)\sin(54.5^\circ)}
\approx 7.976\times 10^3
\]

and

\[
\bar M_n = n m \approx (7.976\times 10^3)(100.02)
\approx 7.98\times 10^5\ \text{g/mol}
\]

**(b) Random-coil chain**

Using the usual freely jointed random-coil estimate with C–C bonds as the chain segments,

\[
r = \sqrt{N}d
\]

where \(N\) is the number of C–C bonds. Hence

\[
N=\left(\frac{r}{d}\right)^2
=\left(\frac{15}{0.154}\right)^2
\approx 9.487\times 10^3
\]

The number of repeat units is \(n=N/2\), so

\[
\bar M_n = \frac{N}{2}m
\approx \frac{9.487\times 10^3}{2}(100.02)
\approx 4.74\times 10^5\ \text{g/mol}
\]
